debug.command: npm install && npx expo prebuild -p android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug

release.command: npm install && npx expo prebuild -p android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease

debug.command: npm install && npx expo prebuild -p ios && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace ExpoTest.xcworkspace -scheme ExpoTest -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath build build

device.command: npm install && npx expo prebuild -p ios && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace ExpoTest.xcworkspace -scheme ExpoTest -configuration Debug -destination generic/platform=iOS -derivedDataPath build -allowProvisioningUpdates build

release.command: npm install && npx expo prebuild -p ios && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace ExpoTest.xcworkspace -scheme ExpoTest -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -archivePath build/App.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/App.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist "$MOBAI_EXPORT_OPTIONS" -exportPath build/ipa -allowProvisioningUpdates
